entry.title: What God Taught Me On Sabbatical | Taking Ground Podcast

media:group.media:title: What God Taught Me On Sabbatical | Taking Ground Podcast
media:group.media:description:
On this episode of the Taking Ground Podcast, Aaron reflects on his summer sabbatical, what God taught him while he stepped away, and what he’s carrying into this next season at Traders Point.
He opens up about the challenges of slowing down, finding his identity beyond what he produces, learning to be present with God, and recognizing the difference between the voice of the Holy Spirit and his own inner critic. The conversation also dives into what it means to steward what God has entrusted to us, resist cynicism, and stay ready for whatever God wants to do next.

entry.title: Presence Over Position | The Urgent Kingdom | Mark 9:30-50 | Full Gathering

media:group.media:title: Presence Over Position | The Urgent Kingdom | Mark 9:30-50 | Full Gathering
media:group.media:description:
What do you want more, a position of importance or the presence of Jesus? In Mark 9:30-50, Jesus is on His way to the cross while His disciples argue about who among them is the greatest. Instead of scolding their ambition, He redirects it, teaching them that true greatness is found not in rank or recognition but in serving without expectation, staying humble, dealing seriously with sin, and living distinctly in a way that brings peace rather than division. God cares about our circumstances, but He is more concerned with the formation of our souls.
Aaron Brockett • The Urgent Kingdom • Mark 9:30-50

entry.title: Help My Unbelief | The Urgent Kingdom | Mark 9

media:group.media:title: Help My Unbelief | The Urgent Kingdom | Mark 9
media:group.media:description:
In Mark 9, we see two stories: Jesus’ glory revealed to Peter, James, and John, and a desperate father pleading for his son. Two scenes, one truth: because of who Jesus is, every challenge in our lives bows to Him. In this message, Executive Ministries Pastor Chad Lunsford teaches how there is no challenge in our lives that is a match for God's glory.
Chad Lunsford • The Urgent Kingdom • Mark 9
